phases.caption: Set up: 2v1 in the attacking third
phases.say: Set up a two versus one in the attacking third. Two attackers, one defender, and the rest waiting their turn.

phases.caption: Nine on the ball, eleven overlaps
phases.say: Nine starts on the ball. Eleven runs wide and beyond. The defender must delay, not dive in.

phases.caption: Carry at the defender
phases.say: Nine carries straight at the defender to commit him.

phases.caption: Release and finish
phases.say: As the defender commits, nine releases eleven on the overlap to finish.

phases.caption: Why it works
phases.say: The defender cannot cover both attackers. Committing him is what creates the free man.

phases.caption: Coaching points
phases.say: Coaching points. Attack the defender, do not drift sideways. Pass late, and finish first time.
